title: Lock Claude Code version; add `athena repin` operator command
summary: Setup disables Claude Code's auto-updater (or installs where it can't write) so the runtime stays at the pin. A new job-free `athena repin` command finds an installed claude whose version differs from `[agents].claude_version`, smoke-tests it, rewrites the pin in athena.toml, and logs an event. Audience: the operator, who runs it after a deliberate upgrade. The current pin (2.1.301) is left unchanged in the repository.

defaults_applied.how: All new code and tests are Rust.
Tests added for repin, failed smoke, and no-op; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria run the command against a stand-in and check the file and event.
A job's pin check passing after repin is the outcome tested.
Updater disabling is enforced in setup, not by prose.
One focused change across setup and one command.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The command is a new `athena repin` subcommand in athena-cli (not an xtask), since 'logs the change as an event' implies the athena event log.
Smoke test = run `claude --version` plus a cheap non-model call such as `claude auth status`, or a --version check parsed to a semver, with no model call.

Auto-updater disabling is done through the DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER environment setting for agents and the private npm install under athena_home, whichever the producer finds supported by the pinned Claude Code.
'Keep the current pin' means the committed athena.toml value is not edited; tests use a temp copy.
Candidate installs searched: `claude` on PATH and the private ~/athena_home/claude-code/<version> directories.

acceptance_criteria.text: Test (run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test repin`): with a stand-in claude reporting a version different from the pin, `athena repin` exits 0, rewrites claude_version in a temp athena.toml to the installed version, preserves the file's other content and comments, and appends a repin event to the event log.
Test (cargo test): after repin in the same temp setup, starting a job passes the pinned-version check (check_pinned succeeds) where it failed before repin.

Test (cargo test): if the smoke test fails (stand-in exits nonzero or misbehaves), repin exits nonzero, leaves athena.toml byte-identical, and logs no repin event; when the installed version equals the pin it changes nothing and says so.

setup.sh/xtask setup disables the Claude Code auto-updater (e.g. DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 in the settings it writes or in the environment agents are launched with), or installs under athena_home where the updater cannot write; a test or the diff shows where this is enforced.
`cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
The athena.toml in the repository still has claude_version = "2.1.301" (current pin kept); the command is documented in README or the CLI help with the operator's one-line usage.
The repin command does not start an agent job and does not require a job record or the model; it works while no job is running.

out_of_scope: Changing the committed pin value in athena.toml
Upgrading Claude Code in the real environment
Changing agent policy or model selection
Live tests that call the model
departures: Larger than the typical job: it spans setup, a new CLI subcommand, event logging and integration tests, so cost and time are above the reference.
